answer: Social Matters >> Rights & Etiquettes Question ID: 8484 Country: India Title: One of my non-muslim friend comes to my home and everytime he touch feet of my dad so i feel very bad when i go to his home and doesn't do it. To give respect to elders can we touch feet of elders, muslims or non-muslims? If not what are the other ways by which we can give them respect. Please suggest. Jazaakumullah... Question: One of my non-muslim friend comes to my home and everytime he touch feet of my dad so i feel very bad when i go to his home and doesn't do it. To give respect to elders can we touch feet of elders, muslims or non-muslims? If not what are the other ways by which we can give them respect. Please suggest. Jazaakumullah... Answer ID: 8484 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1354/200=TL/1429) It is unlawful to bow down and touch feet in respect of anyone whether a Muslim or a non-Muslim. One should adopt the way mentioned in the Quran and Hadith. If one meets an elderly Muslim he should stand up for him and greet him with Salaam , do musafaha (shaking hand) and muanaqah (hugging), but, if he is non-Muslim then one should say السلام علی من اتبع الھدی or adaab arz , but one should not touch feet. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
